products.name: Global-T
products.description: Global-T is a high-performance distributed telemetry and system observability suite engineered for massive global-scale infrastructure. Features sub-millisecond event streaming, kernel-level eBPF tracing, automatic distributed mesh topology visualization, and autonomous anomaly detection.
features: Kernel-level eBPF distributed telemetry collection
Sub-millisecond latency global metric aggregation
Automated network topology dependency mapping
Real-time multi-cloud metric streaming pipelines
High-cardinality time-series analytics engine

products.name: SP-kIT
products.description: SP-kIT delivers ultra-low latency real-time stream processing and high-throughput event routing for mission-critical cyber systems. Optimized for zero-copy memory allocation, parallel pipelining, and fault-tolerant state management across distributed event clusters.
features: Zero-copy memory mapped stream ingestion
High-throughput distributed event broker connector
Deterministic fault recovery and state snapshots
Dynamic micro-batching and windowing operators
Integrated Prometheus & OpenTelemetry instrumentation

products.name: Enternalx
products.description: Enternalx is a premier cyber internal systems architecture and zero-trust service gateway. Provides unified API federation, cryptographic identity-based access control, distributed configuration consensus, and automated resilience management for hybrid cloud deployments.
features: Unified cyber API federation and service mesh
Cryptographic mutual TLS (mTLS) identity verification
Distributed Raft-based configuration synchronization
Automatic circuit breaking and dynamic traffic shedding
Audit-grade compliance telemetry and tamper-evident logging
requirements: Dedicated private VPC or internal cyber network

products.name: M-global
products.description: M-global orchestrates multi-region workloads and global edge computing nodes with instant failover and automated routing. Features automated GeoDNS traffic balancing, hybrid cloud container scheduling, and real-time edge state synchronization.
features: Intelligent GeoDNS and Anycast traffic optimization
Cross-cloud hybrid workload synchronization
Zero-downtime blue/green edge deployments
Edge storage replication with optimistic concurrency
Real-time health probes and autonomous node healing
requirements: Outbound HTTPS connectivity to control plane

products.name: global-c
products.description: global-c is an industrial-grade distributed compute cluster coordinator designed for intense parallel computational workloads, algorithmic simulations, and massive data processing. Features hardware-accelerated scheduling and memory-locality optimizations.
features: Heterogeneous hardware job dispatching (CPU, GPU, FPGA)
NUMA-aware memory scheduling and caching layer
Automated cluster partition re-balancing on node flux
High-efficiency remote direct memory access (RDMA) support
Comprehensive cluster utilization telemetry dashboard
requirements: Clustered server nodes with Linux (RHEL, Ubuntu, Rocky Linux)

products.name: Cryptopro
products.description: Cryptopro provides cyber-grade cryptographic key management, zero-knowledge verification proofs, and post-quantum resilient cryptographic primitives. Built for banking-grade security architectures, audit compliance, and hardened air-gapped cryptographic workstations.
features: Post-quantum lattice-based encryption algorithms (Kyber, Dilithium)
Zero-knowledge zk-SNARK computation and verification suite
HSM integration (PKCS#11 compliant hardware tokens)
Automated cryptographic key rotation and lifecycle policies
Verifiable entropy generation and RNG validation harness
requirements: Hardware Security Module (HSM) or Air-Gapped Linux/Unix host
Python 3.11+ or compiled native binary runtime

products.name: F-SHOOT v9.7.0
products.architecture: Autonomous Diagnostic Engine / Universal Linux & BSD
products.description: F-SHOOT v9.7.0 is the flagship autonomous troubleshooting and system fault-resolution suite for mission-critical tier-1 infrastructure. Features real-time root-cause analysis engines, automated kernel panic analysis, deep network bottleneck isolation, and instant remediation orchestration.
features: Autonomous root-cause diagnosis across 10,000+ infrastructure metrics
Automated kernel coredump and thread deadlock inspector
BGP route flapping and microburst packet-drop isolation
One-click synthetic remediation scripts with rollback guarantees
24/7 dedicated cyber priority telemetry bridge
requirements: Cyber Linux 8+, FreeBSD 13+, or Unix server
Root supervisor permissions for diagnostic probing

products.name: Nessus Expert
products.description: Nessus Expert is the premier vulnerability assessment and external attack surface management solution. Engineered for security consultants and cyber penetration testers to uncover CVEs, misconfigurations, cloud infrastructure weaknesses (IaC), and discover unmapped internet-facing assets.
features: Comprehensive CVE and zero-day vulnerability scanning engine
External Attack Surface Management (EASM) domain discovery
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) security posture scanning (Terraform, CloudFormation)
Over 75,000+ pre-built compliance and configuration audit checks
Low false-positive rate with CVSS v3 prioritized remediation guidance
requirements: Windows 10/11, Windows Server, Linux (RHEL, Ubuntu, Debian), or macOS
Minimum 8GB RAM (16GB recommended for cyber ranges)
Internet connectivity for live plugin updates

products.name: Cobalt Strike
products.architecture: Team Server & Asynchronous Beacon C2 Framework
products.description: Cobalt Strike is the industry-standard adversary simulation software designed for mature red teams and elite penetration testers. Emulates advanced persistent threat (APT) tactics, featuring stealthy in-memory post-exploitation, customizable Malleable C2 network profiles, and collaborative multi-operator team servers.
features: Malleable C2 network traffic profile evasion and shaping
Asynchronous Beacon agent with in-memory reflective DLL loading
Collaborative multi-operator Team Server architecture with session sharing
Comprehensive MITRE ATT&CK adversary technique replication
Covert pivoting, SOCKS proxy tunneling, and browser exploitation harness
requirements: Linux Team Server (Ubuntu 20.04+, Debian, or Kali Linux)
Dedicated command-and-control server infrastructure with public IP

products.name: Cymulate
products.description: Cymulate provides automated breach and attack simulation (BAS) to continuously test and validate cyber security posture. Evaluates endpoint detection (EDR), email gateways, web filters, and internal network perimeters against current threat intelligence campaigns in safe, controlled environments.
features: Continuous automated multi-vector attack path validation
Endpoint security & EDR evasion stress-testing framework
Email gateway phishing and weaponized payload filtering validation
Web Application Firewall (WAF) and DLP egress bypass assessment
Actionable mitigation guidance and automated SIEM/SOAR integration
requirements: Lightweight agent for Windows, Linux, or macOS test endpoints
Web browser access for centralized SaaS command console
Outbound HTTPS connectivity to validation cluster

products.name: Core Impact
products.description: Core Impact is an cyber-grade automated penetration testing and vulnerability validation platform. Enables security teams to safely replicate real-world multi-vector attacks across networks, endpoints, web applications, and Wi-Fi using commercially developed, peer-reviewed exploits.
features: Commercially certified, stable exploit library with zero collateral risk
Multi-stage automated pivoting across compromised network segments
Web application penetration testing and OWASP Top 10 vulnerability checks
Bi-directional vulnerability scanner import (Nessus, Qualys, Rapid7)
Executive and technical regulatory compliance reporting (PCI-DSS, ISO 27001)
requirements: Network interface supporting promiscuous mode for network discovery

products.name: Metasploit Pro
products.description: Metasploit Pro is the comprehensive commercial penetration testing platform by Rapid7. Accelerates security assessments with automated exploitation wizards, dynamic payload antivirus evasion, team collaboration workspaces, credential harvesting, and integrated social engineering simulations.
features: Automated Quick PenTest wizard for rapid network-wide vulnerability validation
Dynamic payload generation with advanced anti-virus / EDR evasion
Cyber team collaboration with multi-user access controls and shared workspaces
Automated credential harvesting, tag analysis, and credential re-use testing
Comprehensive compliance audit logs and customizable report generation
requirements: Ubuntu Linux, Red Hat Cyber Linux, Kali Linux, or Windows Server
Minimum 8GB RAM (16GB recommended for concurrent scans)
